question: Through what ordered faculties does inward-turning consciousness move?
premises: Consciousness is described as moving or going
Its range follows a sequence of inward face, eye, and related faculties
inference: Inward consciousness traverses an ordered field of faculties such as face and eye turned within
uncertainties: Exact referents of mukha and akṣi in this inward sequence are interpretive
plain_english: This belongs to consciousness moving through the sequence of the inward-turned face, eye, and other faculties.
